findings.F1: Pronoun-position learner error has incorrect and correct swapped.
findings.F2: Sense 1 definition omits the intransitive use declared in its grammar and shown in the oven example.
findings.F3: disable-v is not a true synonym of turn off.
findings.F4: The open/close-the-light trap is stated in both the learner errors and the false_friends adaptation note.
findings.F5: Sense 3 is labeled formal but is informal.
findings.F6: The pronunciation adaptation note duplicates pronunciation.notes.
findings.F7: switch-on-phrv, an antonym, is listed as a synonym.
